meta.title: Ninh Bình, VIETNAM - Best Places to Visit | Travel Guide Itinerary #ninhbình
meta.description:
100km south of Hanoi, the magical Ninh Binh, located in northern Vietnam, is also known as the "Ha Long Bay on Land" for an obvious reason – it looks like Ha Long Bay but on land instead of water.

We spent 2 days 3 nights in Ninh Binh, trying to fit in all the best attractions into our itinerary. Ninh Binh is one of my most favourite places so far in Vietnam. Personally, I prefer Ninh Binh than Ha Long Bay as it offers more places to see :) I recommend to stay in Tam Coc area as it's the centre of all the tourist spots and restaurants.
